newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares end slightly down, eye Fed meeting.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares end slightly down, eye Fed meeting.

text.p: Jakarta shares ended slightly lower on Tuesday as trade was cautious ahead of a policy-making meeting of the U.S. Federal Reserve, brokers said.
The Jakarta Composite Index fell 0.4 points, or 0.07 percent, to close at 569.77 points after touching an intra-day low of 566.79 points in late morning trade.
Losers led gainers by 55 to 50, with 52 counters unchanged.

Brokers said market sentiment on Wednesday would be guided by the outcome of the Federal Reserve meeting later on Tuesday. "The result of the Fed meeting could either boost or put pressure on sentiment," said one foreign broker.

Volume was boosted by cross-trading on certain stocks, including car maker Astra International with 54.3 million shares, cocoa producer Davomas with 35 million shares and polyster manufacturer Polysindo with 10 million shares.

Brokers said foreigners concentrated on a few big-capitalised stocks including Astra, cement producer Semen Gresik, cigarette maker Sampoerna and satellite firm Indosat. Most secondaries were the target of profit-taking, they said.
Astra topped the active list with 17.8 million shares changing hands. It rose 125 rupiah to 3,725 rupiah after falling to 3,550 on profit-taking early in the afternoon.
Brokers said the rises were due to continued talk that a tycoon would buy a stake in the company. No confirmation was available.
Glass and plastics manufacturer Igar Jaya rose 400 rupiah to 3,150 on a volume of 3.3 million shares on market talk of a possible take-over, brokers said.
